text:
Liam (partnerships): FYI CloudMarket asked for hourly aggregates aligned to their billing window (PST midnight-to-midnight), plus weekly CSV snapshots and on-demand backfill via presigned S3 links. They also want explicit rounding rules, timezone fields, and a dedupe_key for retries.
Nadia: Hourly windows are fine, but PST alignment per-customer is trickier (customers in EMEA/APAC). We should send both timestamp_utc and window_local_start with local_tz offset.
Victor: +1. Also clarify "units" normalization: they expect tokens/1000 for generation, embeddings per-emb-vector unit. Let's publish a mapping table for SKUs -> unit divisor.
Dana (finance): For invoicing we need meter_id and plan_id columns. Marketplaces handle tax so we don't have to include tax breakdown, but include invoice_reference optional. Also they requested that negative adjustments (corrections) be explicit and include replaces_event_id.
marketplace-bot: Policy reminder: SKU strings must be <=100 chars and alphanumeric with dots/underscores.
sre-bot: Created ticket #INC-4628 to evaluate ingest throughput for hourly pushes + presigned downloads.
Nadia: Proposed JSON webhook payload sample:
```
{
  "event_id": "evt_02H3Y9LQW1",
  "dedupe_key": "cv-987-20260315-13",
  "customer_id": "cv-cust-987",
  "meter_id": "mw.redwood.tokens",
  "plan_id": "enterprise-monthly",
  "timestamp_utc": "2026-03-15T21:00:00Z",
  "window_local_start": "2026-03-15T13:00:00-08:00",
  "local_tz": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "sku": "redwood.infer.generation.tokens",
  "units": 1234.567,
  "units_rounding": "3dp_half_up",
  "correction": false,
  "replaces_event_id": null,
  "source": "batch-aggregator-v2",
  "signature": "sha256=..."
}
```
Victor: Rounding policy proposal: keep 3 decimal places in the usage stream (half-up). Final invoice aggregation rounds up to next integer unit. So 0.001 -> 1 on invoice. We'll document examples.
Dana (finance): For backfill CSVs: zipped CSV + manifest.json. CSV columns: event_id,timestamp_utc,window_local_start,local_tz,customer_id,meter_id,plan_id,sku,units,units_rounding,correction,replaces_event_id,source,source_job_id. Manifest must contain {"file_name":"...",
